description_zh: 异步创建管道/非结构化工作流
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public create-pipeline-by-async --op-tenant-id 30001011 --context ProjectId=123 Env=DEV --create-command '{"ScheduleConfig":"cronExpression_:_0_0_0_0_0_0","Comment":"comment","PipelineConfig":{},"NodeInfo":{},"PipelineType":0,"Mode":"PIPELINE","Submit":true,"PipelineJson":"example-string","Settings":"example-string"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipelineByAsync

fields.help_en: Current operating environment env: DEV - indicates the development environment, PROD - indicates the production environment (for workflows, only PROD is currently supported)
fields.help_zh: 当前操作环境 env：DEV-表示操作开发环境，PROD-表示操作生产环境（对于工作流，目前仅支持 PROD）
fields.name: env

fields.help_en: Project ID to which the integration pipeline/workflow task belongs
fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流任务所属项目 ID
fields.name: project_id

fields.help_en: Comment
fields.help_zh: 备注
fields.name: comment

fields.help_en: Integration pipeline configuration mode: PIPELINE - indicates pipeline mode (default), JSON - indicates script mode. This is not applicable to workflows
fields.help_zh: 集成管道配置模式：PIPELINE-表示管道模式（默认），JSON-表示脚本模式。 如果为工作流，则无需关注
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Integration pipeline task node directory (defaults to the root directory). The directory must exist. If it does not exist, call the relevant API to create a directory of type offlinePipeline
fields.help_zh: 集成管道任务节点目录（默认为根目录），该目录必须存在，如若不存在，则需要调用相关接口创建类型为offlinePipeline的目录
fields.name: directory

fields.help_en: Pipeline file ID. Leave empty for the first creation. When updating a pipeline task, at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId must be configured
fields.help_zh: 管道文件ID，首次创建为空，更新管道任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: file_id

fields.help_en: Pipeline task scheduling node ID. Leave empty for the first creation. When updating a pipeline task, at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId must be configured
fields.help_zh: 管道任务调度节点ID，首次创建为空，更新管道任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: node_id

fields.help_en: Integration pipeline task name
fields.help_zh: 集成管道任务名称
fields.name: node_name

fields.help_en: Pipeline task ID. Leave empty for the first creation. When updating a pipeline task, at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId must be configured
fields.help_zh: 管道任务ID，首次创建为空，更新管道任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: pipeline_id

fields.help_en: Integration pipeline task basic information
fields.help_zh: 集成管道任务基本信息
fields.name: node_info

fields.help_en: For conditional distribution components, set to true when the downstream connection condition is true, otherwise set to false. This is not applicable to workflow tasks
fields.help_zh: 针对条件分发组件，连接下游条件为 true 时设置为 true，否则设置为 false。 如果为工作流任务，则无需关注
fields.name: send_to

fields.help_en: Input step name, i.e., Steps[*].StepName
fields.help_zh: 输入步骤名称，即Steps[*].StepName
fields.name: source

fields.help_en: Output step name, i.e., Steps[*].StepName
fields.help_zh: 输出步骤名称，即Steps[*].StepName
fields.name: target

fields.help_en: DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) link configuration: describes the connection relationships of all components
fields.help_zh: DAG有向无环图链接配置：描述所有组件的连接关系
fields.name: hops

fields.help_en: Indicates the data distribution method when the current component has multiple downstream components: true - indicates that the data of the current component is sent to all downstream components in a round-robin manner. For example, if the current component has 100 records and two downstream components, each downstream component receives 50 records. The default value is true. false - indicates that the data of the current component is sent in full to all downstream components. For example, if the current component has 100 records and two downstream components, both downstream components receive 100 records. This value is not applicable to workflow tasks
fields.help_zh: 用于表示当前组件有多个下游组件时当前组件数据的分发方式： true-表示当前组件的数据轮流发送到所有下游，例如当前组件有 100 条数据，有两个下游，则两个下游各有 50 条数据，默认为 true， false-表示当前组件的数据全量发送到所有下游，例如当前组件有 100 条数据，有两个下游，则两个下游都有 100 条数据。 如果为工作流任务，则无需关注此值
fields.name: is_distribute

fields.help_en: Plugin ID. Each plugin/operator has a unique identifier. Refer to the utility class: com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepKey. Developers should extend the component/operator configuration class to implement the corresponding component/operator configuration. Each component/operator configuration has the same structure as a configuration created on the Dataphin page
fields.help_zh: 插件 ID，每个插件/算子都有唯一的标志，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepKey。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与 Dataphin 页面创建的配置结构相同
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: Specific component configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the utility class: subclasses of com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig (for workflow operators, use com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.unstructured.BaseOAUnstructuredNeuronConfig) and their toJsonString methods. Developers should extend the component/operator configuration class to implement the corresponding component/operator configuration. Each component/operator configuration has the same structure as a task configuration created on the Dataphin page
fields.help_zh: 具体组件配置，格式为 JSON 字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig（工作流算子则为 com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.unstructured.BaseOAUnstructuredNeuronConfig）相关子类的 toJsonString 方法。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与 Dataphin 页面创建的任务配置结构相同
fields.name: plugin_config

fields.help_en: Step name. Step names must be unique within the same pipeline task
fields.help_zh: 步骤名称，在同一个管道任务所有步骤名称不能重复
fields.name: step_name

fields.help_en: Component type: input - indicates an input component, output - indicates an output component, transform - indicates a transform component, process - indicates a flow control component. For workflow tasks, it indicates the operator type, for example: image - image, text - text. Refer to the utility class: com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepType. Developers should extend the component/operator configuration class to implement the corresponding component/operator configuration. Each component/operator configuration has the same structure as a configuration created on the Dataphin page
fields.help_zh: 组件类型：input-表示输入组件，output-表示输出组件，transfrom-表示转换组件，process-表示流程控制组件，对于工作流任务则表示算子类型，例如：image-图片，text-文本。参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepType。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与 Dataphin 页面创建的配置结构相同
fields.name: step_type

fields.help_en: Component/operator configuration: contains detailed configurations of all components/operators used
fields.help_zh: 组件/算子配置：包含所有用到的组件/算子详细配置
fields.name: steps

fields.help_en: Integration pipeline component/workflow operator configuration
fields.help_zh: 集成管道组件/工作流算子配置
fields.name: pipeline_config

fields.help_en: In script mode: integration pipeline configuration (in JSON string format). Workflow tasks do not support script mode
fields.help_zh: 脚本模式下：集成管道配置（json 字符串格式）。 工作流任务不支持脚本模式
fields.name: pipeline_json

fields.help_en: Task type: 0 - indicates offline integration (default), 1 - indicates real-time integration, 14 - indicates a workflow task
fields.help_zh: 任务类型：0-表示离线集成（默认），1-表示实时集成，14-表示离线工作流任务，15-表示实时工作流
fields.name: pipeline_type

fields.help_en: Scheduling configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the utility class: com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAScheduleConfig#toJsonString method
fields.help_zh: 调度配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAScheduleConfig#toJsonString方法
fields.name: schedule_config

fields.help_en: Channel configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the utility class: com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAPipelineSetting#toJsonString method
fields.help_zh: 通道配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAPipelineSetting#toJsonString方法
fields.name: settings

fields.help_en: Whether to submit. The default is to submit
fields.help_zh: 是否提交，默认提交
fields.name: submit

parameters.help_zh: 创建管道/工作流任务配置
parameters.name: create_command
